data.gender_notes: Pratyush is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pratyush is a Sanskrit word which means 'dawn' or 'daybreak'. It symbolizes the beginning of a new day and brings hope with it. It is a name for those who are eager to start a new phase in their lives or want to bring positivity and hope to their loved ones. The name Pratyush carries the meaning “dawn, daybreak, hope” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pratyush usually hope their child will grow to embody dawn, daybreak, hope and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pratyush is a Sanskrit word that signifies the divine light of dawn. It represents the spiritual awakening and the beginning of a new cycle of life. The name is believed to bring blessings of hope, positivity, and new beginnings.
data.etymology: Pratyush belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “dawn, daybreak, hope.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pratyush total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
